relationships.relation_statement: Set d=3, points=9-k and tangencies=k, for 0<=k<=9, and take the open locus of smooth curves. These are the same generic finite point-and-line-tangency problems.
relationships.evidence_location: Stored descriptors and parameter lists; dimension of the projective space of plane cubics is 9.
relationships.inheritance_policy: No automatic inheritance. A result may be transferred only after explicitly checking its hypotheses, parameter specialization, solution convention and genericity.
relationships.caveats: For the generic finite count, singular cubics form a lower-dimensional boundary and are excluded. Statements concerning boundary multiplicities or special input configurations require separate analysis.
